findings.root_cause_of_legacy_100_percent: The legacy generator used deterministic disjoint feature assignments per class (e.g. fee_difference_minor only set for FEE_MISMATCH, duplicate_payment_count only for DUPLICATE_PAYMENT). 9 of 11 classes had perfect 1-feature decision bounds.
findings.upgraded_generator_improvements: The upgraded generator injects realistic operational noise, cross-feature confounders (e.g. natural refunds and adjustments across normal transactions), continuous timing distributions, and strict group-based separation across 12 distinct business archetypes. The holdout test set tests models on unseen business models.
